Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Pringle
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 635 as introduced adds a judge of probate and a municipal judge to the membership of the Alabama Justice Information Commission, which could increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency, by an estimated minimum of $1,400 annually, for reimbursement of travel expenses of these additional commission members.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
